core_obligations: Recognize the statement as the theorem on formal functions specialized to a base ring which is Noetherian and complete for the ideal (proof lines 4493-4495).
Use finiteness of $H^p(X, \mathcal{F})$ over the Noetherian ring $A$ to conclude that this module is $I$-adically complete (proof lines 4495-4498).
Conclude that completing the left hand side changes nothing, so that $H^p(X, \mathcal{F}) = \lim_n H^p(X, \mathcal{F}/I^n\mathcal{F})$ (proof lines 4498-4499).
proof_roadmap: Recognition of the statement as the formal functions theorem (proof lines 4493-4495).
Finiteness and completeness of the cohomology modules (proof lines 4495-4498).
difficulty_reason: The lemma records the form of the theorem on formal functions over a complete Noetherian base ring, where the completion of the cohomology modules on the left hand side is redundant (statement lines 4480-4490). The proof invokes the general theorem, uses the finiteness of the cohomology of a coherent sheaf on a proper space over a Noetherian affine base to know that the modules are already complete, and thereby identifies the limit description with the cohomology itself. The comparison between completion and the finite module is the substance, so the claim is H2.
